scope: Manual HMR CLI checks for explicit TypeScript target and useDefineForClassFields transform settings.

implementation.target_mapping: Read an explicit tsconfig target when present. Otherwise use the pinned TSRS TypeScript 7 default (latest standard target), independently of module kind. HMR keeps Quench's native JavaScript syntax target instead of downleveling source to the application's output target.
implementation.class_fields: Use explicit useDefineForClassFields when present; otherwise derive the mode from the TypeScript target. The false mode enables assignment semantics and removes type-only fields without initializers.
